verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs state that Terminal provides official SDKs for iOS and Android (plus React Native) for building a custom POS integration. They also cover Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android through the Terminal SDK, a built-in simulated reader for developing without hardware, and a versioned SDK migration guide (v5.0.0), which together show a mature mobile SDK offering. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the iOS/Android SDKs specifically (the community comments discuss API-level integration generally, and the only GitHub evidence is the JS SDK).
